1.en: The Prophet frowned and turned away

2.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

3.en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

4.en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

5.en: As for he who thinks himself without need,

7.en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

8.en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

11.en: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

12.en: So whoever wills may remember it.

17.en: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

18.en: From what substance did He create him?

19.en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

20.en: Then He eased the way for him;

21.en: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

22.en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

23.en: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

24.en: Then let mankind look at his food -

25.en: How We poured down water in torrents,

26.en: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

27.en: And caused to grow within it grain

32.en: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

33.en: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

34.en: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

35.en: And his mother and his father

36.en: And his wife and his children,

37.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
37.en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

38.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

40.en: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

42.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
